ops.en: THE MESSAGE. hine avikha CHOLE — 'behold, your father is ILL': the illness-word enters the patriarchs' story at its close (the readings on Jacob asking for illness before death, that a man may order his house, are the chain's — the machine files the letter: the deathbed scene is CONVENED, not stumbled into); va-yiqach et SHENE vanav — Joseph brings the two the adoption will claim.

THE BLESSING IS DOUBTED BY ITS OWN WITNESSES [claim G71-26]. Coming out with his face glowing, Joseph draws the brothers' verdict: everyone attaches himself to the successful one - he blesses him because he is king. The father answers from the Psalms. The same suspicion the coat drew at the start of the cycle, recorded as the brothers' stated position rather than as narration. This verse is also t…

THE STRENGTHENING [G71-09]. va-YITCHAZEQ yisrael — 'and Israel STRENGTHENED himself': the dying man sits up for the blessing-hour; va-yeshev AL ha-mita — 'and sat UPON the bed': the upon-the-bed adjacency, the Torah's ONE (47:31 bowed at the bed's HEAD; 49:33 will gather the feet INTO it — the span's bed-triple), and the Kitzur's file closes on Esther: the righteous, even weak, STRENGTHEN on the b…

THE RECALL. EL SHADAY nira elai be-LUZ — Jacob opens the adoption with the deed to it: the Luz appearance (35:9-12, gen_58's span — where the name Israel was written and the nation-promise given): the machine notes the legal shape — the grandfather cites his covenant before amending his house.

THE EVERLASTING HOLDING. mafrekha ve-hirbitikha — the fruitful-and- multiply verbs quoted from the covenant's mouth (35:11; narrated done on the family at 47:27); ACHUZAT OLAM — 'an EVERLASTING holding': the machine sets the two holdings side by side — the achuza Pharaoh's Egypt gave (47:11) against the achuzat olam God swore in Canaan: one is administration, one is covenant; the deathbed chooses …

THE GRAMMAR OF AN OLD BLESSING BECOMES THE WARRANT FOR AN ADOPTION [claim G71-27]. 'A nation' is read as Benjamin and 'an assembly of nations' as Manasseh and Ephraim; here the patriarch quotes the promise back, and in the very next verse he cashes it by adopting the two. The credit was recorded at its own block naming this one as its seat. [folded shape: kept record]

THE ADOPTION [G71-13]. LI-HEM — 'MINE they are': the grandfather claims the Egypt-born pair; ke-REUVEN ve-SHIMON — 'as Reuben and Simeon': the firstborn and the second displaced in one comparison — and the Kitzur's letter-count finds the equivalence EXACT: Ephraim- and-Manasseh = Reuben-and-Simeon in the letters' own arithmetic (named [G71-13]). The machine's restraint: the adoption is filed as a …

THE CALLING CLAUSE [G71-08]. al shem achehem YIQARU — 'by the name of their brothers THEY SHALL BE CALLED': the passive they-shall-be- called, its one Torah station by vocalization [VERIFIED: manifest G71-08] — the Kitzur pairs it with Levi's sons (named): Joseph's later sons called through their brothers' allotments as the landless tribe is called through everyone's cities — the two called-not- c…

THE APOLOGY [G71-04; G71-10]. meta ALAI rachel — 'Rachel died ON ME' (the on-me of bereavement, the readings hear the wound); LAVO efrata — 'to COME to Ephrath': the come-word LEAN — the Hilleli writes it full, the Yerushalmi lean, all the books lean, and the Masorah's own mnemonic for the NINE lean stations sits at this verse (the Ramah concurs): the stream's bare-skeleton census reads EIGHT in t…

THE QUESTION. va-YAR yisrael — 'and Israel SAW' — and asks MI ELE ('who are these?'): the see-verb over eyes the next verses call too heavy to see (48:10): the readings resolve it (the Presence departed; the seeing is dim recognition asking for formal presentation) — named; the machine files the question as the adoption's procedural step: the blessing requires identification, as the deceived fathe…

THE SUMMONS [G71-06]. banai hem asher natan li ELOHIM ba-ZE — 'my sons, whom GOD has given me IN THIS PLACE' (the identification rendered, God in the answer as in Joseph's every answer); QACHEM na elai — 'TAKE THEM, pray, to me': the take-them word unique in the Torah [VERIFIED: manifest G71-06] — and its one Scripture-partner is Hosea's qamats-twin: 'I taught Ephraim to walk, TAKING THEM on His a…

THE NEARING [G71-05]. va-YAGESH otam elav — 'he brought them NEAR to him': the take-them demand discharges in the next verse (the nearing-verb of 44:18's confrontation now a grandfather's reach); ve-ene yisrael KAVDU mi-ZOQEN — 'Israel's eyes were heavy FROM AGE': the from-age word, its ONE Torah token [VERIFIED: manifest G71-05] — and the Kitzur closes the circle: as Isaac's eyes DIMMED and Jacob…

THE UNJUDGED SEEING. reo fanekha lo FILALTI — 'to see your face I had not JUDGED' (the judge-verb for expectation: he had not dared reckon it); ve-hine hera oti Elohim GAM et zarekha — 'God has shown me your SEED too': the seeing-file's third station (the resolve 45:28 'I will see him'; the meeting 46:30 'after seeing your face'; now the seed beyond the face): the machine notes the ledger of sight…

THE BOW [G71-10]. va-yotze yosef otam me-im BIRKAV — from between the KNEES (the adoption-posture of the readings: the knees that claim); va-yishtachu le-APAV artza — the bow with the face to the earth: the pe of the face-word DAGESHED [VERIFIED under G71-10]; the machine notes the dream-arithmetic silently completing: the father who would not be counted bowing (37:10's protest) bows to no one her…

THE PLACEMENT [G71-10]. et EFRAYIM bimino mi-SEMOL yisrael, ve-et MENASHE vi-SEMOLO mi-YMIN yisrael — the governor stages the scene as he staged the trial and the audience (the machine's standing pattern-note): geometry arranged so the right hand falls on the firstborn; vi-semolo with the bet and shin SOFT (asserted under G71-10); va-yagesh elav — the nearing repeated: everything is correct, excep…

THE CROSSING [G71-11; G71-12]. va-yishlach yisrael et YEMINO — the right hand SENT (the send-verb of missions on a hand); SIKEL et yadav — 'he CROSSED his hands WISELY': the wise-crossing verb, its ONE Torah token, minted for this gesture [VERIFIED under G71-11]; ve-hu ha-TZAIR — 'and he was the YOUNGER': the definite younger- word, ALSO its one Torah token, planted where the right hand lands [VER…

THE BUFFER SUPPLIES THE INTENT THE HEBREW LEAVES TO INFERENCE [claim G71-24]. The difficult verb is not rendered; instead the translation states the act and its reason - he placed his hands SO DELIBERATELY, EVEN THOUGH MANASSEH WAS THE FIRSTBORN. The objection is answered inside the same clause, and the precedence census then confirms the act across the later books. [folded shape: dual-track trans…

THE BLESSING OPENS. va-yevarekh et YOSEF — 'and he blessed JOSEPH': the letter blesses the father through the sons (the readings: the sons are Joseph's blessing — a father's greatness is his children); ha-Elohim ha-ROE oti — 'the God who SHEPHERDS me': Jacob the shepherd of Laban's flocks names God by his own trade — the trade Egypt abominates (46:34) is the verse's name for God (the machine files…

A DISPUTE ABOUT DEPENDENCE, DECIDED IN TRANSLATION AGAINST ONE NAMED OPINION [claim G71-23]. One master sees a SHEPHERD whose flock walks before him - the walking is for our sake. The other sees a KING with ELDERS walking before him - the walking is honor paid. Onkelos votes twice for the second, rendering the walking as SERVED and the shepherding as SUSTAINED. The losing reading stays on the reco…

THE ANGEL'S CLAUSE [G71-07; G71-11]. ha-MALAKH ha-GOEL oti mi-kol RA — 'the ANGEL who REDEEMS me from all evil' (the wrestler, the ladder's company, the entity registry's UNCERTAIN file — the machine cites, it does not merge); yevarekh et ha-NEARIM — may he bless the LADS (the lad-word that carried Benjamin through gen_67 now carries Joseph's two); ve-YIQARE vahem SHEMI — 'let my name BE CALLED in…

A DEFLECTION NOT MADE, WHICH IS ITSELF THE DATUM. The translation that removes hands, weapons and bodily organs throughout this cycle KEEPS the angel here rather than deflecting it, and renders the multiplying verb explicitly as LIKE FISH. Recorded because the buffer's silence is only legible against its habits. [folded shape: dual-track translation]

THE DISPLEASURE. va-YERA be-enav — 'it was EVIL in his eyes': the evil-in-eyes idiom (38:10's judgment formula on Onan; 28:8's on the Canaanite wives) now on the son judging the father's hands; va- YITMOKH yad aviv — he TAKES HOLD of the father's hand: the only physical correction attempted on a patriarch's blessing in the corpus — the machine files the hand on the hand before the word against the…

THE CORRECTION DEMANDED [G71-03]. lo khen AVI — 'NOT SO, my father': the governor who arranges everything demands the arrangement back; ki ze ha-BEKHOR — 'for THIS is the FIRSTBORN' — and the firstborn- word is written LEAN: the Hilleli writes it full, the Yerushalmi lean, all accurate books lean (the Masorah's four-full list, mnemonic at the Miketz section, excludes it; the Ramah: the rest all le…

THE REFUSAL [G71-13]. va-yeMAEN aviv — 'and his father REFUSED': the refuse-verb flat (39:8's refusal was Joseph's own — the letter hands it back); YADATI veni YADATI — 'I know, my son, I know' doubled: the knowing that Isaac's dimmed scene lacked, stated twice — the crossing is not error but sight (the Kitzur's counts: yadati = the five kings from Manasseh; melo — 'the fullness' = JOSHUA by the l…

THE REFUSAL IS READ AS KNOWLEDGE, NOT AS STUBBORNNESS. The doubled 'I know' is taken as the elder knowing what his own house had done - the bed of Reuben and the affair of Judah and Tamar - so the hand that will not move is a hand that has already weighed the family. A standing row from the sale block, seated here on its verse. [folded shape: kept record]

THE FORMULA [G71-01 MARQUEE; G71-02]. va-yevarakhem ba-yom ha-hu LEMOR — and the saying-word is written FULL with the vav: the Torah's ONLY full lemor ('saying'), first word of the formula-verse, while the SAME verse writes the word again LEAN four tokens on — one verse, one word, both spellings: the full mouth for the blessing every generation will say, the lean for the stage direction (MS sends …

A GESTURE VERIFIED AS A STANDING PRECEDENCE, GRADED LEG BY LEG [claim G71-21, machine-checked]. The chain builds nine items from this verse - the younger first ever after. THE TORAH LEGS HOLD AT ALL THREE SEATS: the lineage lists Ephraim before Manasseh; the banners place his standard first with Manasseh set beside him; and the princes' offerings give Ephraim THE SEVENTH DAY and Manasseh THE EIGHT…

THE RETURN CLAUSE. hine anokhi MET — 'behold, I DIE' (said plainly, the deathbed's own grammar); ve-HESHIV etkhem el eretz AVOTEKHEM — 'and He will RETURN you to your fathers' land': the covenant's return-clause spoken to the generation that will die in Egypt — the machine arms the long file: Joseph will repeat the clause word-for- shape at his own death (50:24, this run's last block) and the seco…

A POLICY, NOT A LOCAL CHOICE [claim G71-25]. 'God will be WITH YOU' becomes 'the WORD of God will be YOUR SUPPORT' - the same construction the buffer used in the prison house and will use again in the next block's blessing. Divine presence is stated as the Word's support, never as bare accompaniment. [folded shape: dual-track translation]

THE PORTION [G71-13]. SHEKHEM achad al achekha — 'ONE PORTION above your brothers': the portion-word IS the town's name (the entity registry's shekhem file: town and son, split by scope, never merged — the machine cites): the readings land the grant at the town — the plot Jacob bought (33:19) where Joseph's own BONES will rest (Josh 24:32, named: the bones-file's ground deeded here, one verse afte…

TWO WITNESSES TAKE THE WEAPONS OUT OF ONE VERSE, BY TWO DIFFERENT METHODS [claim G71-22]. Onkelos substitutes the instruments - with MY PRAYER and with MY PLEA. The chain reassigns their ownership - the sword is not yours, it is Esau's, its title traced to the blessing of 27:40.
